item.title: Good Storage & Distribution Practice (GSDP): JFDA Requirements & Compliance Guide | PHARPRO
item.dc:creator: Mohammad Awawdeh
item.description: Comprehensive GSDP guide for pharmaceutical companies in Jordan: what Good Storage and Distribution Practice is, JFDA requirements for storage and distribution facilities, WHO GDP alignment, and how PHARPRO helps achieve and maintain compliance — including temperature monitoring, GDP documentation, and inspection readiness.
item.content:encoded:
Good Storage & Distribution Practice (GSDP): JFDA Requirements & Compliance Guide

Good Storage and Distribution Practice (GSDP) — also called GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — governs how pharmaceutical products are stored and distributed to preserve quality, safety, and efficacy throughout the supply chain. In Jordan, JFDA enforces GSDP requirements for pharmaceutical warehouses, distributors, and wholesalers.

This guide covers: what GSDP is and why it matters, JFDA requirements for storage facilities (temperature-controlled storage, cold chain, humidity control), GDP documentation requirements, common GSDP inspection findings, and how PHARPRO helps companies achieve full GSDP compliance — from gap assessment through to inspection readiness.

Learn more and enquire: https://www.pharpro.co/insights/gsdp-good-storage-distribution-practice/
